criteria_definitions.name: Leaderboard Rank #1
criteria_definitions.description: Candidate must achieve Rank 1 overall tournament score on the official leaderboard.

criteria_definitions.name: Title / Deep Run Superiority
criteria_definitions.description: Candidate must outperform random expectation by >= 2.0x in titles (runs >= field) or final table rate (runs < field).

criteria_definitions.name: Positive Expected Value (BB/100)
criteria_definitions.description: Candidate must maintain strictly positive BB/100 across the tournament.

criteria_definitions.name: Top 12 Deep Run Qualification Rate
criteria_definitions.description: Candidate preliminary playoff qualification rate must outperform random expectation by >= 1.5x (>= 15% in 120-player field).

criteria_definitions.name: Benchmark Dominance & Tournament EV
criteria_definitions.description: Candidate must achieve >= 50% pairwise win rate or superior tournament EV against all declared baseline models.
